newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Netanyahu to Russia March 10-12.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Netanyahu to Russia March 10-12.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will make his first official visit to Russia on March 10 to 12, Netanyahu's office said on Sunday.
It said Netanyahu, who took office last June after winning Israeli elections in May, would meet Russian President Boris Yeltsin and other top officials on March 11.
The Israeli leader is also slated to meet with Russian businessmen and Jewish community leaders in Moscow. On March 12, he will visit St. Petersburg before returning to Israel.
Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin extended an invitation to Netanyahu to make the visit while he was in Israel last November.
